page_title: MNU 1-3 BHA | Manchester Utd v Brighton 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+8' Booking. Solly March (Brighton) receives a caution from the referee.
90+8' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Leny Yoro (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Brighton will take a free kick.
90+5' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90+5' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul. Brighton earn a free kick.
90+5' Carlos Baleba goes off the pitch and Diego Gomez (Brighton) comes on.
90+5' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Joao Pedro is replaced by Julio Enciso (Brighton).
90+2' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+1' That's unlucky! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Manchester Utd earn a corner.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The current number of shots on goal is 1:3. The total number of attempts is 9:6.

89' What a big chance! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
86' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) attempts to feed Antony with a chip pass, but Bart Verbruggen reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pervis Estupinan will be replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
84' Substitution. Joshua Zirkzee walks off the pitch and Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
84' Substitution. Noussair Mazraoui makes his way off the pitch and Antony (Manchester United) comes on as his replacement.
83' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

83' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.

80' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
79' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
78' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Peter Bankes signals. That's a free kick to Manchester Utd.
76' 1 - 3 Goal! Andre Onana makes a huge mistake and Georginio Rutter (Brighton) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:3.

74' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
73' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
73' Toby Collyer (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton are awarded a free kick.
71' Solly March (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
70' The resulting corner from Solly March (Brighton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
69' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to substitute Danny Welbeck and he is replaced by Georginio Rutter (Brighton).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Solly March (Brighton) will replace Yankuba Minteh.
68' An attempted cross from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
67' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches a cross from the corner, but Bart Verbruggen is alert to thwart the effort. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Ruben Amorim has decided to make a change. Toby Collyer (Manchester United) replaces Manuel Ugarte.
64' Substitution. Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) has come on for Kobbie Mainoo.
61' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

60' 1 - 2 Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) meets a perfect cross from Yankuba Minteh deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:2.

59' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
57' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andre Onana, who smothers the ball.
56' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Brighton due to a foul in the build-up play. Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
55' The Brighton players halt their celebrations as referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
53' Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
52' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) takes a direct free kick.
52' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul. Brighton have a free kick.
49' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

49' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
47' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Referee Peter Bankes blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Joao Pedro (Brighton) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45+2' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
45+1' It seemed like Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is penalised for holding. Peter Bankes signals a set piece. Manchester Utd win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
43' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is penalised for a foul. Peter Bankes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
42' What a great touch by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
40' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
37' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It's a throw-in for Brighton.

33' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
23' 1 - 1 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Bart Verbruggen to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
22' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
21' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) trips an opposition player and Peter Bankes signals a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Manchester Utd.
21' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
19' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
17' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
12' Peter Bankes blows for a foul after Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Brighton win a free kick.
11' Referee Peter Bankes sees the trip by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
6' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Kaoru Mitoma provides Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 0:1.

2' Joao Pedro (Brighton) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Andre Onana pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Brighton will kick-off.
Peter Bankes is the one to supervise the game today.
